integrity: Analytic proof supplied; finite code checks supplement it. Related elementary corner integral is not claimed as new. Priority is provisional pending independent full bibliographic review.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed full-dimensional parallelograms, four independent samples with one point uniformly distributed along each specified side, and independent area-uniform spatial evaluation. No pooled-perimeter or general-quadrilateral assertion. The two asymptotics concern the deterministic depth function evaluated at a uniform point, not random hull-area tails.
title: Two universal endpoint laws for pointwise coverage by side-stratified parallelogram hulls
